speaker: D. Todd Christofferson
role: Second Counselor in the First Presidency
title: O Be Wise
summary: President Christofferson speaks plainly against gambling, which the smartphone has made constant, private and everywhere, especially through online sports betting, casino games and prediction markets that hit youth hardest. He uses President Hinckley's retelling of Calvin Coolidge ("He was against it"), Paul's warning about eating meat offered to idols, and President Oaks's "opportunity cost" to show that gambling harms others, takes something for nothing and leads away from Christ's giving path. He pleads with members to refrain from gambling even for fun, to use the time and money saved to do good, and, with Jacob, to "be wise."

audience.who: All members, with particular concern for youth and young adults and for parents whose example others watch
